preconditions.description: The length of the string n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of allowed letters p is between 1 and 26 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:p] for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is one of the first p letters of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: all(s[i] != s[i+1] for i in range(len(s)-1))
preconditions.description: The string s does not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more.

postconditions.expression: return_value in ['NO'] or (all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:p] for c in return_value) and all(return_value[i] != return_value[i+1] for i in range(len(return_value)-1)) and all(ord(return_value[i]) <= ord(s[i]) for i in range(len(s))) and any(ord(return_value[i]) > ord(s[i]) for i in range(len(s))))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or a lexicographically next tolerable string of the same length, which is larger than the given string and does not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more.
